_source: Blender EEVEE demo 'Temple' by Dominik Graf, CC-BY — https://mirror.blender.org/demo/eevee/temple/temple.blend
_note: Walkable surface is the `Grass` mesh; the craggy `Landscape_Small` lies ~4 m below it, so ground raycasts must target Grass. Character stands on the level crest (z~12.4, y 25-33) directly in front of the great pagoda (Story_Large: x -27..0, roofs start y~34, top z 64). Cameras sit down-slope (y 13-21, ground 5-10) with a clear view up to the crest and tilt up so the tower fills the top of frame.
